MODUL = 1000000007

def mod_multiply(a, b, m):
    res = 0
    a %= m
    b %= m
    while b > 0:
        if b & 1:
            res = (res + a) % m
        a = (a + a) % m
        b >>= 1
    return res

def mod_power(base, exp, m):
    res = 1
    base %= m
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = mod_multiply(res, base, m)
        base = mod_multiply(base, base, m)
        exp >>= 1
    return res

    ans = mod_power(p_in, p_in - 1, MODUL)
elif k_in == 1:
